headline: Congress takes a breath—both chambers meeting in pro forma sessions Thursday as the legislative calendar stays quiet.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met briefly in pro forma session on Monday, October 19, convening at 9:00 a.m. and adjourning at 9:00:31 a.m. No business was conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met for a brief session on Monday, October 19, introducing 15 public bills (H.R. 10840-10854) and 5 resolutions (H. Res. 1629-1633) before adjourning. No votes were taken.
